content_units: Use these as read-aloud quiz questions or handout cards. Difficulty is medium, with a mix of film, TV, music, theater, and video games.
Which 1999 film features the line, “I see dead people”?
Why:   The line is famously spoken by Haley Joel Osment’s character in M. Night Shyamalan’s supernatural thriller.
What is the name of the fictional paper company in the U.S. version of  The Office ?
Why:   The Scranton branch of Dunder Mifflin is the central workplace setting for most of the series.
Which artist released the album  Back to Black ?
Why:    Back to Black  was Amy Winehouse’s landmark 2006 album and includes several of her best-known songs.
In  Les Miserables , which character sings “On My Own”?
Why:   “On My Own” is Eponine’s signature solo about unrequited love for Marius.
In the original  Super Mario Bros. , what is the name of Mario’s brother?
Why:   Luigi is Mario’s brother and longtime co-star across the Nintendo franchise.
Which actor played Maximus in  Gladiator  (2000)?
Why:   Crowe’s performance as the Roman general Maximus is one of the film’s defining elements.
In  Friends , what instrument does Phoebe Buffay usually play while performing?
Why:   Phoebe’s offbeat songs, especially “Smelly Cat,” are typically performed with her acoustic guitar.
Lyric clue: “Is this the real life? Is this just fantasy?” Name the song.
Why:   Those are the opening lyrics of Queen’s iconic rock epic.
Which musical tells the story of Alexander Hamilton primarily through hip-hop and R&B?
Why:    Hamilton  became famous for blending American history with contemporary musical styles.
What is the name of the kingdom where most main-series  The Legend of Zelda  games are set?
Why:   Hyrule is the recurring fantasy kingdom associated with Link, Zelda, and Ganon.
- Best flow: ask all 10 questions first, then read out answers at the end.
- Suggested scoring: 1 point per correct answer, 10 points total.
- Tie-break idea: ask teams to name any two songs from  Back to Black .
- These questions rely on widely established entertainment facts and do not require current-news updates.
